item.title: Round Rock Express to host Fan Fest on March 21 at Dell Diamond
item.description: AUSTIN (KXAN) — Professional baseball is almost back at Dell Diamond, but the Round Rock Express wants to celebrate all of their fans before the games begin. Fan Fest hits the ballpark from 10 a.m.-2 p.m. March 21, and fans of all ages can enjoy numerous activities to get ready for spring, free of charge. [...]

item.title: Elite pitching staffs take center stage in SEC opener between Texas, Ole Miss
item.description: The No. 2 Longhorns bring a perfect 16-0 record into their first SEC series of the season, hosting Ole Miss — one of the nation's other elite pitching staffs — in Austin this weekend.

item.title: Sean Miller 'at peace' as Texas awaits NCAA Tournament fate
item.description: Texas coach Sean Miller says he's "at peace" with whatever Selection Sunday brings after the Longhorns fell to Ole Miss in the SEC Tournament — but he's not sugarcoating it. Miller called missing the NCAA Tournament a "failure," while framing the loss as a "necessary step" in rebuilding a program he inherited just one year ago. item.title: Austin Police chief detains aggravated assault suspect at Central Library
item.description: Austin Police arrested a man after officers responded to a disturbance call at the Austin Central Library on Wednesday shortly before noon.

item.title: Corpus Christi officials work to diversify water system in the face of emergency
item.description: Now -- because of what will likely be a historic drought for the region -- two of the most reliable sources of surface water for the city of Corpus Christi have dwindled to the lowest levels in history.

item.title: SXSW: Free events that don't require a badge
item.description: There will be hundreds of events, showcases, activations, and panels happening at South by Southwest throughout the next week or so. If you don't have a badge, don't get FOMO just yet. There are plenty of happenings for folks who aren't credentialed.

item.title: Leander ISD names lone finalist in search for new superintendent
item.description: Leander ISD has named a lone finalist in the district's search for a new superintendent.

item.title: APD: Deadly altercation at downtown Austin bank determined to be act of self defense
item.description: Austin Police said a deadly altercation in downtown Austin Wednesday was determined to be an act of self defense.

item.title: Parents upset over Round Rock ISD's plans to end several bus routes
item.description: Round Rock Independent School District plans to discontinue several bus routes for the upcoming school year, a move that could affect 892 students who currently use those routes.

item.title: APD explains why there was no active shooter alert in Sixth Street tragedy
item.description: Following the March 1 mass shooting on West Sixth Street that left at least 15 injured and four others – including the gunman – dead, Austin police are now explaining why the agency did not request an active shooter alert to warn people nearby of potential danger.
